notes: TWO GENUINELY INDEPENDENT ENDPOINTS, and better sourced than the register claimed - 2 per strand has THREE separate supports across two documents, 3 per strand has one. The asymmetry is the point and it is published: the low end is demonstrated at kilogram GMP and at 1 L, the high end only in microplates at a tenth of the concentration. The point value of 3 remains THIS PROJECT'S assumed disconnection, not the demonstrated case. Direction check, re-done and it HOLDS but not for the register's stated reason: under EQ-SPOS combined with EQ-PURITY, the floor for an n-mer in k blocks is y^(n-k) times g^(k-1) where y is per-cycle yield and g is junction purity, and the sign flips at g = y. At any realistic ligation purity g is below y, so more blocks does mean a lower floor. What the model does not admit is that it freezes the per-block purity while varying the block count, when that purity is itself a function of block length (Q-058). The real opposing force is not purity against purity, it is purity-per-block against ligation yield and complexity.
